_comment: Hand-curated demo cameras, chosen by VISUAL INSPECTION of live frames on
2026-08-04 -- not by name matching. Name matching is unreliable here:
it selected bridge decks (WBB-20 @ Above Bedford Ave), elevated highway
ramps (Canal Street @ Chrystie Street), a skyline-facing camera (Queens
Plaza N @ Northern Blvd), and one camera with a dirty/hazed lens (Queens
Blvd @ 39 St - East). None of those can show double parking.
Selection criteria: local commercial street, camera looking DOWN the
roadway (not across it), visible curb lane with parked vehicles, and
enough resolution on the near half of the frame to resolve a vehicle.
All NYC DOT snapshots are 352x240. Re-verify this list before a demo --
cameras get repositioned and go offline.

cameras.name: Amsterdam Ave @ 60 St
cameras.notes: Looks down a commercial one-way. Delivery vans routinely stopped in the travel lane; double parking was visible in the very first frame sampled.

cameras.name: Northern Blvd @ 114 St
cameras.notes: Dense curbside parking on both sides with clearly separated travel lanes. Good separation between parked row and moving traffic.

cameras.name: Grand Concourse @ Bedford Park Blvd
cameras.notes: Busy local corridor with street vendors. High vehicle density; expect more false positives from congestion.

cameras.name: Atlantic Ave @ 111 St
cameras.notes: Local commercial street, parked cars both sides, clean lane structure.

cameras.name: Columbus Ave @ 65 St
cameras.notes: Upper West Side local street with steady delivery activity.

cameras.name: Flatbush Ave @ Eastern Pkwy
cameras.notes: Wide intersection view. Vehicles are small in frame; keep as a backup camera.

rejected.name: WBB-20 @ Above Bedford Ave ( Berry St )
rejected.reason: Williamsburg Bridge deck -- limited-access, no double parking

rejected.name: Canal Street @ Chrystie Street
rejected.reason: Elevated bridge approach ramp, not the surface street

rejected.name: Queens Plaza N @ Northern Blvd
rejected.reason: Camera framed on skyline/bridge, roadway is a small fraction of frame

rejected.name: Broadway @ 45 St
rejected.reason: Times Square -- heavy pedestrian occlusion, atypical traffic pattern
